memories.content: CNA cutoff for FCC metals must be (a0/sqrt(2) + a0)/2 ≈ 0.854*a0. For Cu (a0=3.615): cutoff = 3.086 Angstroms. Do NOT use 1.207*a0 (= 4.365 for Cu) — that value is too large because it includes the 2nd nearest-neighbor shell (18 neighbors instead of 12), causing CNA to classify ALL atoms as Unknown/Other (type 5).
